capabilities: Render color cards from fenced code blocks with hex, RGB, CMYK, and PMS values
Display brand palettes as horizontal strips of swatches
Show inline color dots next to hex codes in notes
Edit hex values by clicking a swatch to open a color picker
Insert colors via slash command, ribbon icon, paste detection, or clipboard commands
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README references screenshots in an assets folder that appear as placeholders.
problem: Raw hex codes in notes give no visual sense of the color and no derived values like RGB, CMYK, or PMS for design documentation.
summary: Renders hex codes as interactive color cards and palette strips with RGB, CMYK, and PMS values, inline dot previews, and click-to-edit.
